payload.title: Regime transition probability on synthetic ensembles
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook aims to recreate Figure 7 from a publication by analyzing the Linear Empirical Regime Model (LERM) applied to synthetic ensembles. It focuses on producing a combined Kernel Density Estimate (KDE) figure for both abrupt and gradual regime transition examples. The notebook loads data from ODP and NGRIP records, defines functions for transition detection, and plots results using pre-calculated data. The primary output is a visual representation of regime transitions using KDE plots.
goals: Recreate Figure 7 from the original publication.
Analyze LERM applied to synthetic ensembles.
Produce a combined KDE figure for regime transitions.
